Been a while since someone who didn't stink of Pals washed up here.

This island is a living hell. The people I came with are all gone...
Those damned Pals ate every one of 'em.
You be careful out there.

Here, take some basic supplies.
You need to toughen up if you want to survive out there.

TextData.SourceString:
...I'm so tired.
I tried making graves for everyone at first,
but when more than a hundred died, I gave up on that idea.
TextData.LocalizedString:
...I'm so tired.

TextData.SourceString:
Here, ignorance leads to death.
There's a sliver of hope to be had if you manage to tame a Pal,
but not one of my comrades was able to accomplish that.

The Rayne Syndicate controls that place. They're a dangerous group.
You'll be killed for sure if you go now. My friends who tried ended up dead just like that.

Marcus, the PIDF leader, keeps this village safe.
It's thanks to him that we can live in peace and quiet.

Be smart and do what I do. Let the PIDF protect you and focus on your own business.

Some friendly advice: prepare for some intense heat if you plan on going any deeper in.

Rumors say there's a legendary Pal living somewhere in the desert.
There's a never-ending stream of fools who stroll deep into the desert, never to be seen again.

If you're gonna take on the desert, don't fall into the same rut. Make sure you're well prepared.
Here, take this. It'll come in handy!

I'd stop while you're ahead if you don't wanna throw away that precious life of yours.
I've lived in this village a long time, and I ain't never seen no legendary Pal.

He's even got the PIDF protecting us. There's a lot who thank him for that.
He keeps the peace around here.

Wonder what they're doing in a place like that...

TextData.SourceString:
The boss is up near the tower.
If the PIDF can get their hands on some ancient technology, they'll be unstoppable.
I bet the boss would be able to control the whole island!

Bonfires are so nice... Nothing beats the crackles and pops of a roaring flame.
Don't you agree?

TextData.SourceString:
Back in the day, you couldn't go on about mundane stuff like this.
Every day was a struggle between life and death... But everything changed when he came.
Thanks to him, we can live like proper human beings.
TextData.LocalizedString:

These days, you can make a bonfire like this without having to worry about attracting thieves.
This feeling of joy at something so simple... It's worth being thankful for.

Humans can't live without fire.

I nearly died after getting hit by a truck while on the job.
When I came to, I was on this island.

What rotten luck, getting assigned to some fishing village in the boonies...

TextData.SourceString:
Another boring day...
Yeah, yeah, no worries, I'm guarding the place...
TextData.LocalizedString:
Another boring day...
Yeah, yeah, no worries, I'm guarding the place...

TextData.SourceString:
Who're you? Guess it doesn't matter.
Look, this is just some plain old fishing village.
Take a load off and relax.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Who're you? Guess it doesn't matter.
Look, this is just some plain old fishing village.
Take a load off and relax.

TextData.SourceString:
This place isn't all so bad, you know. It's a great place to sit around doing nothing.
Having nothing of note is both its greatest advantage and its greatest disadvantage.
TextData.LocalizedString:
This place isn't all so bad, you know. It's a great place to sit around doing nothing.
Having nothing of note is both its greatest advantage and its greatest disadvantage.

TextData.SourceString:
Anyway, I found this lying around. Want it?
Not sure what it is, but it smells a bit like used ammo.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Anyway, I found this lying around. Want it?
Not sure what it is, but it smells a bit like used ammo.

TextData.SourceString:
So that's what they call <itemName id=|Sulfur|/>, huh?
I remember seeing some stuff like that up on the volcano.
Don't you think it smells like ammo?
TextData.LocalizedString:
So that's what they call <itemName id=|Sulfur|/>, huh?
I remember seeing some stuff like that up on the volcano.
Don't you think it smells like ammo?

TextData.SourceString:
Thanks for the help. 
The security around here has gone downhill lately.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Thanks for the help. 
The security around here has gone downhill lately.

TextData.SourceString:
Appreciate the backup.
Keep an eye out for those poaching crews.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Appreciate the backup.
Keep an eye out for those poaching crews.

TextData.SourceString:
And here I thought I had finally escaped that blasted desert...
Nobody told me there was something that big living on this island!
TextData.LocalizedString:
And here I thought I had finally escaped that blasted desert...
Nobody told me there was something that big living on this island!

TextData.SourceString:
Dang... If only I had what it takes to be a Pal Tamer!
I could catch a Pal, build a base, and survive out there!
TextData.LocalizedString:
Dang... If only I had what it takes to be a Pal Tamer!
I could catch a Pal, build a base, and survive out there!

TextData.SourceString:
Don't you go dying out there...
Here, take this. Be quick and prepare against enemy attacks.
If you don't, you'll be dead meat when night falls.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Don't you go dying out there...
Here, take this. Be quick and prepare against enemy attacks.
If you don't, you'll be dead meat when night falls.

TextData.SourceString:
Be extra careful if you run into any giant Pals.
They'll kill you in a heartbeat if you're not armored up.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Be extra careful if you run into any giant Pals.
They'll kill you in a heartbeat if you're not armored up.

TextData.SourceString:
You're new around here, aren't you?
A fellow wanderer, huh...
Why did I have to end up in a dump like this?!
TextData.LocalizedString:
You're new around here, aren't you?
A fellow wanderer, huh...
Why did I have to end up in a dump like this?!

TextData.SourceString:
I bet you're also just trying to catch some Pals and get rich quick, right?
Bad news, turns out Pals are ferocious, dangerous creatures.
All my friends have already kicked the bucket...
TextData.LocalizedString:
I bet you're also just trying to catch some Pals and get rich quick, right?
Bad news, turns out Pals are ferocious, dangerous creatures.
All my friends have already kicked the bucket...

TextData.SourceString:
If you come across a giant Pal, steer clear of it.
Make sure you're well prepared before trying to take it on.
Catch a bunch of Pals and try to level up first.
TextData.LocalizedString:
If you come across a giant Pal, steer clear of it.
Make sure you're well prepared before trying to take it on.
Catch a bunch of Pals and try to level up first.

TextData.SourceString:
Be wary of giant Pals.
First, you need to catch as many Pals as you can.
You'll need lots of experience if you want to take one on.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Be wary of giant Pals.
First, you need to catch as many Pals as you can.
You'll need lots of experience if you want to take one on.

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, it's pretty rare to have anyone come through here.
You won't find anything interesting.
The Syndicate took everything we had.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Oh, it's pretty rare to have anyone come through here.
You won't find anything interesting.
The Syndicate took everything we had.

TextData.SourceString:
If you can make Pal Spheres,
you can catch Pals and surround yourself with bodyguards.
This island is ruled by the law of the jungle...
TextData.LocalizedString:
If you can make Pal Spheres,
you can catch Pals and surround yourself with bodyguards.
This island is ruled by the law of the jungle...

TextData.SourceString:
I'm so tired... Just let me be free...
Here, let me give you some of my supplies.
I'll have no use for them anyways...
TextData.LocalizedString:
I'm so tired... Just let me be free...
Here, let me give you some of my supplies.
I'll have no use for them anyways...

TextData.SourceString:
I used to be a tough tamer like you...
Then I took a hit to the knee from that giant Pal.
On this island, those who can't fight can only wait for death to come to them.
TextData.LocalizedString:
I used to be a tough tamer like you...
Then I took a hit to the knee from that giant Pal.
On this island, those who can't fight can only wait for death to come to them.

TextData.SourceString:
H-Help! I don't wanna be here anymore!
A giant, scary Pal attacked us!
It chewed up and spit out humans like they were toys...
TextData.LocalizedString:
H-Help! I don't wanna be here anymore!
A giant, scary Pal attacked us!
It chewed up and spit out humans like they were toys...

TextData.SourceString:
You have to catch some Pals and build a base before night comes!
You can't win in the dark of night!
Build a bonfire, hide, and pray until daybreak.
TextData.LocalizedString:
You have to catch some Pals and build a base before night comes!
You can't win in the dark of night!
Build a bonfire, hide, and pray until daybreak.

TextData.SourceString:
Use this however you can...
You have to survive, and escape this island!
TextData.LocalizedString:
Use this however you can...
You have to survive, and escape this island!

TextData.SourceString:
If you run into some bloodthirsty Pals in the dark of night, you're done for...
Make a Hand-Held Torch, or build a base
and wait out the night somewhere safe...
TextData.LocalizedString:
If you run into some bloodthirsty Pals in the dark of night, you're done for...
Make a Hand-Held Torch, or build a base
and wait out the night somewhere safe...

TextData.SourceString:
Are you...a castaway? What rotten luck finding yourself here!
This whole area is known as Palpagos Island.
It's a terrible place where everything is decided by violence.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Are you...a castaway? What rotten luck finding yourself here!
This whole area is known as Palpagos Island.
It's a terrible place where everything is decided by violence.

TextData.SourceString:
Some people come from outside looking to catch some Pals,
but most end up missing, never to be found.
They either get eaten by wild Pals, or the Rayne Syndicate takes them out...
TextData.LocalizedString:
Some people come from outside looking to catch some Pals,
but most end up missing, never to be found.
They either get eaten by wild Pals, or the Rayne Syndicate takes them out...

TextData.SourceString:
If you're a Pal Tamer, you need to catch lots of Pals.
Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they catch.
You might increase your chances of survival, too.
TextData.LocalizedString:
If you're a Pal Tamer, you need to catch lots of Pals.
Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they catch.
You might increase your chances of survival, too.

TextData.SourceString:
Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they catch.
You might increase your chances of survival
on this living hell of an island...
TextData.LocalizedString:
Pal Tamers get stronger the more Pals they catch.
You might increase your chances of survival
on this living hell of an island...

TextData.SourceString:
How many years has it been since anyone washed up here?
The last person who wound up here was some famous merc,
but they ended up just getting eaten by a Direhowl.
TextData.LocalizedString:
How many years has it been since anyone washed up here?
The last person who wound up here was some famous merc,
but they ended up just getting eaten by a Direhowl.

TextData.SourceString:
Pals are way more brutal than they look.
If you come across a carnivorous Pal, you best run.
Don't even think about looking back.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Pals are way more brutal than they look.
If you come across a carnivorous Pal, you best run.
Don't even think about looking back.

TextData.SourceString:
Here, use this. I'll be praying for
your survival in this cruel place.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Here, use this. I'll be praying for
your survival in this cruel place.

TextData.SourceString:
We're close to that snow-covered mountain, so it gets fairly cold here.
You should hurry up and build a bonfire or a hut,
and get some rest in a nice, warm bed before you set out.
TextData.LocalizedString:
We're close to that snow-covered mountain, so it gets fairly cold here.
You should hurry up and build a bonfire or a hut,
and get some rest in a nice, warm bed before you set out.

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, now that's a sight.
You're a Pal Tamer too, aren't you?
TextData.LocalizedString:
Oh, now that's a sight.
You're a Pal Tamer too, aren't you?

TextData.SourceString:
My goal is to become the strongest Pal Tamer.
Care to test your skills in a duel?
Of course, island customs dictate that it would be a fight to the death.
TextData.LocalizedString:
My goal is to become the strongest Pal Tamer.
Care to test your skills in a duel?
Of course, island customs dictate that it would be a fight to the death.

TextData.SourceString:
That means we'll both be putting our lives on the line.
Well? Wanna fight?
TextData.LocalizedString:
That means we'll both be putting our lives on the line.
Well? Wanna fight?

TextData.SourceString: Glad you said that! Let's make it a great battle!
TextData.LocalizedString: Glad you said that! Let's make it a great battle!

TextData.SourceString:
That's prudent of you.
Once you've found your resolve, come here again.
TextData.LocalizedString:
That's prudent of you.
Once you've found your resolve, come here again.

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, I've found me a Pal Tamer!
I've been itching to see how strong I've gotten!
TextData.LocalizedString:
Oh, I've found me a Pal Tamer!
I've been itching to see how strong I've gotten!

TextData.SourceString:
You're going to net me a nice bunch of experience points.
Let's fight!
TextData.LocalizedString:
You're going to net me a nice bunch of experience points.
Let's fight!

TextData.SourceString: You'll need more than enthusiasm to win!
TextData.LocalizedString: You'll need more than enthusiasm to win!

TextData.SourceString:
What a coward.
And you call yourself a Pal Tamer?
TextData.LocalizedString:
What a coward.
And you call yourself a Pal Tamer?

TextData.SourceString:
Heheheh...
So you're the Pal Tamer everyone's been talking about.
They say you've gotten pretty good for a rookie.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Heheheh...
So you're the Pal Tamer everyone's been talking about.
They say you've gotten pretty good for a rookie.

TextData.SourceString:
What an eyesore.
I'll snuff out your fifteen minutes of fame now.
Get those Pal Spheres ready.
TextData.LocalizedString:
What an eyesore.
I'll snuff out your fifteen minutes of fame now.
Get those Pal Spheres ready.

TextData.SourceString:
Hmph, did you think you could win?
Know your place.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Hmph, did you think you could win?
Know your place.

TextData.SourceString: Never call yourself a Pal Tamer again, you coward.
TextData.LocalizedString: Never call yourself a Pal Tamer again, you coward.

TextData.SourceString:
Hey there, rookie!
Looks like you've gotten the hang of using Pals.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Hey there, rookie!
Looks like you've gotten the hang of using Pals.

TextData.SourceString:
But meeting me here... Looks like your luck is at an end.
Let's fight to see which one of us is the real Pal Tamer.
TextData.LocalizedString:
But meeting me here... Looks like your luck is at an end.
Let's fight to see which one of us is the real Pal Tamer.

TextData.SourceString: I'll show you how a veteran brawls!
TextData.LocalizedString: I'll show you how a veteran brawls!

TextData.SourceString: Disappointment isn't always bad.
TextData.LocalizedString: Disappointment isn't always bad.

TextData.SourceString:
Whoa! What do we have here!
You look reeaaaal tough!
TextData.LocalizedString:
Whoa! What do we have here!
You look reeaaaal tough!

TextData.SourceString:
C'mon, let's fight!!
I'm talking a reeeaaal fight!
TextData.LocalizedString:
C'mon, let's fight!!
I'm talking a reeeaaal fight!

TextData.SourceString: Let's make this one helluva battle!
TextData.LocalizedString: Let's make this one helluva battle!

TextData.SourceString: Laaaamee!
TextData.LocalizedString: Laaaamee!

TextData.SourceString:
Great... Another Pal Tamer meow?
There's been way too many weaklings these days.
I wish somebody else would take care of all of 'em meow.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Great... Another Pal Tamer meow?
There's been way too many weaklings these days.
I wish somebody else would take care of all of 'em meow.

TextData.SourceString:
If you're gonna fight with me, you're gonna have to show a little pluck.
And when you lose, make sure you kneel meow.
TextData.LocalizedString:
If you're gonna fight with me, you're gonna have to show a little pluck.
And when you lose, make sure you kneel meow.

TextData.SourceString: No way you're gonna win, stupid kitten meow.
TextData.LocalizedString: No way you're gonna win, stupid kitten meow.

TextData.SourceString: So you're weak and a coward. What a hoot, meow.
TextData.LocalizedString: So you're weak and a coward. What a hoot, meow.

TextData.SourceString:
These Pals, or whatever they're called, have an awful stench. It makes me want to vomit.
Don't you agree?
TextData.LocalizedString:
These Pals, or whatever they're called, have an awful stench. It makes me want to vomit.
Don't you agree?

TextData.SourceString:
Hm? Not in the business? Must be a wanderer then.
Sorry, I've got nothing to sell you.
I'm delivering these goods to the next village over.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Hm? Not in the business? Must be a wanderer then.
Sorry, I've got nothing to sell you.
I'm delivering these goods to the next village over.

TextData.SourceString:
Y'know, there are these weirdos who throw away their money.
I just wanna sell off my stock
and get off this blasted island.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Y'know, there are these weirdos who throw away their money.
I just wanna sell off my stock
and get off this blasted island.

TextData.SourceString:
I don't give a damn about what happens to this trash.
All I care about are my goods.
Go on, try and put a scratch on 'em. I'll make you pay good.
TextData.LocalizedString:
I don't give a damn about what happens to this trash.
All I care about are my goods.
Go on, try and put a scratch on 'em. I'll make you pay good.

TextData.SourceString:
Hi there, Pal Tamer.
We're a merchant group that's here to support you...
Just kidding.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Hi there, Pal Tamer.
We're a merchant group that's here to support you...
Just kidding.

TextData.SourceString:
You're just a little too good at making people hate you.
Don't take it personally. It's just business.
Any final words?
TextData.LocalizedString:
You're just a little too good at making people hate you.
Don't take it personally. It's just business.
Any final words?

TextData.SourceString:
See that huge structure towering over the ocean?
That's a Syndicate oil rig.
It's a dangerous place, so make sure to stay away from it.
TextData.LocalizedString:
See that huge structure towering over the ocean?
That's a Syndicate oil rig.
It's a dangerous place, so make sure to stay away from it.

TextData.SourceString:
Hey, let me hook you up with some Pals.
Wanna check 'em out?
TextData.LocalizedString:
Hey, let me hook you up with some Pals.
Wanna check 'em out?

TextData.SourceString: Go with the sketchy surgery.
TextData.LocalizedString: Go with the sketchy surgery.

TextData.SourceString: Here goes nothing.
TextData.LocalizedString: Here goes nothing.

TextData.SourceString: I don't trust you.
TextData.LocalizedString: I don't trust you.

TextData.SourceString:
My name is Dr. Brawn! I'm a genius scientist pushing boundaries of pal science. 
I've been waiting for an eager guinea pig... Uh- I mean, collaborator like you!
TextData.LocalizedString:
My name is Dr. Brawn! I'm a genius scientist pushing boundaries of pal science. 
I've been waiting for an eager guinea pig... Uh- I mean, collaborator like you!

TextData.SourceString:
Shall I conduct the latest Brawn Surgery on {SpawnedOtomo}?
If it succeeds, the result will be absolutely mind-blowing! ...Probably!
So, what do you say? Ready to let {SpawnedOtomo} go under the knife?
TextData.LocalizedString:

TextData.SourceString:
If, by some twisted miracle, the surgery goes wrong, {SpawnedOtomo} could end up with a 
permanent, irreversible, and absolutely terrifying side effect that’ll haunt them for life!
But I know you, my trusted partner in science, would still be all in for the sake of progress, correct?

TextData.SourceString:
Ah... kids these days just don't have the guts to dedicate themselves to science. 
Back in my day, it was different! I used to conduct tests on myself in pursuit of higher knowledge!

TextData.SourceString:
Let's get started! First, the State-of-the-Art Transformation Ray!
Click... Click.. Oh, these readings are..? Nah, shouldn't be a problem!
Zzzp...zzZZzap.. Now... the moment of truth! BOOM!!!!

TextData.SourceString:
You're awake! Unmistakably radiant... Incredible!
…Knew it'd turn out splendidly. A true masterpiece!
TextData.LocalizedString:
You're awake! Unmistakably radiant... Incredible!
…Knew it'd turn out splendidly. A true masterpiece!

TextData.SourceString:
...You're awake? Uh, well...
I guess being alive is something to be thankful for...
Cutting-edge research always comes with its costs. Don't let it get you down.
TextData.LocalizedString:
...You're awake? Uh, well...
I guess being alive is something to be thankful for...

TextData.SourceString:
Hmm? Where is the test subject? 
It seems you don't have any Pals with you.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Hmm? Where is the test subject?

TextData.SourceString:
My focus is completely fried today.
Come back tomorrow if you want to push the boundaries of Pal science!
TextData.LocalizedString:
My focus is completely fried today.
Come back tomorrow if you want to push the boundaries of Pal science!

TextData.SourceString:
Well, well...I'm the esteemed gourmet critic and chief advisor to the Palpagos Gourmet Society.
I'll grace your dish with my refined palate, young upstart.
Though I doubt a drifter like you could possibly satisfy my discerning tastes.

I expect you to present me with {RequireCount} of your {ItemName}.
Rest assured, I have prepared a suitable reward for your efforts.

TextData.SourceString: Keep it.
TextData.LocalizedString: Keep it.

TextData.SourceString:
Aspara-gasp! This is a Frying pan-tastic {ItemName}.
As much as it pains me to admit, I must say it's delicious.
As promised, I shall reward you generously. Thank you.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Aspara-gasp! This is a Frying pan-tastic {ItemName}.

What? You say you don't have {ItemName}?
That’s disappointing... like a burnt pancake.
TextData.LocalizedString:
What? You say you don't have {ItemName}?
That’s disappointing... like a burnt pancake.

TextData.SourceString:
Oh... You say you will not offer me a meal?
I may starve to death... that's a recipe for disaster!
It would be a great loss to the world if that were to happen.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Oh... You say you will not offer me a meal?
I may starve to death... that's a recipe for disaster!
It would be a great loss to the world if that were to happen.

TextData.SourceString:
Your culinary creations... I've savored them all.
It's been ages since my taste buds were so impressed... 
I'm truly satisfied... I’m off to my next course... Farewell.

Your culinary creations... I've savored them all.

I'm truly satisfied... I’m off to my next course... Farewell.

TextData.SourceString:
Hmph... I am the chief judge of the World Pal Exhibition.
I came to this region to see {PalName}, but it got away.
I will give you the honor of showing me {PalName}. You may thank me later.

I see... So this is the rumored {PalName}. A splendid specimen... truly splendid. 
Hmph... Indeed, this was worth a look. 
Here's your reward. Impress me again next time.

TextData.SourceString:
Foolish... To appear without {PalName} at such an opportunity.

I've seen enough of your Pals... I'll allow you to leave as your reward.
Your display was more impressive than I anticipated...
Consider yourself thanked. Surprisingly, I found it quite enjoyable.

Nice to meet you. I'm researching Pal species and conducting an ecological survey, 
including unidentified species in this area...
You have a Palpedia, don't you? Would you mind showing it to me for reference?

Nice to meet you. I'm researching Pal species and conducting an ecological survey,

If you manage to catch more species, I'd be happy to reward you for your efforts. 
Would you be willing to help me with my research?

If you manage to catch more species, I'd be happy to reward you for your efforts.

Please accept this reward as a token of my appreciation.

Fantastic! You've recorded {DexCount} species! 
This is incredibly valuable research data.

If you discover any, please come show me!

Thanks to you, I've achieved remarkable research results.
I'll make sure to credit you by name in my research paper.

This is an astonishing amount of data... It's more than enough.

I'll make sure to credit you by name in my research paper.

Your eyes are no ordinary ones...
A gaze sharp as that of a hunter, truly remarkable.
I have a task I wish to entrust to someone of your skill.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Your eyes are no ordinary ones...
A gaze sharp as that of a hunter, truly remarkable.
I have a task I wish to entrust to someone of your skill.

TextData.SourceString:
The mad ones who disturb this land, and the horrors that have overrun it,
I ask that you hunt them down.
TextData.LocalizedString:
The mad ones who disturb this land, and the horrors that have overrun it,
I ask that you hunt them down.

TextData.SourceString:
...Rest assured. I do not ask for free labor.
A fair reward will be properly prepared for you.
Once you have finished the hunt, return to me once more.

...Rest assured. I do not ask for free labor.

TextData.SourceString:

It’s over… it’s all over…
TextData.LocalizedString:
Our ship is destroyed, and we don’t even know which way we’re going…
The only thing we were counting on, the flying Pals, was shot down by missiles…
It’s over… it’s all over…

TextData.SourceString:
...I was once under Jarl Bjorn's comand, It feels arrogant to even introduce myself.
The words of a coward who fled... are hardly worth hearing, I'm sure.
Nevertheless, there is something I wish to pass on to those who set foot on this island.

TextData.SourceString:
There are scattered Feybreak Army camps across this island… 
and there, you'll find anti-air missile turrets.

Weapons that automatically attack objects flying at high speed… 
terrifying machines.
If you value your life, stay on the ground.

terrifying machines.
If you value your life, stay on the ground.

TextData.SourceString:
Also, stay away from the tower.
Jarl Bjorn is still haunted by past wars.
Without a moment's hesitation, the Feybreak Army will attack as soon as they see outsiders.

TextData.SourceString:
I feel pathetic for having run away. But I couldn’t keep up with that war-thirst madman.
Jarl Bjorn is too strong. He’s a being that has surpassed the limits of humanity.
We mere mortals can never hope to match him.

TextData.SourceString:
If you ever get stuck somewhere and can't move, 
you can use the Emergency Escape feature in the Options tab of the menu.

TextData.SourceString:
You'll drop your items and equipment, 
but you'll instantly return to your base.

You'll drop your items and equipment,

TextData.SourceString: If there's truly no way to get out, it's worth a try.

TextData.SourceString:
When you faint, you'll drop some of the items you were carrying,
but a pillar of light will mark the spot, so you can easily find them.

TextData.SourceString:
You can pick up your items by touching any part of the pillar.
If you use a flying Pal to reach it from above, 
you can safely retrieve them—keep that in mind!

TextData.SourceString:
Research Team Members: 
While we've only uncovered a mere fraction 
of the mysteries present on the Palpagos Islands, 
there have been multiple reports regarding the stone statues scattered about the isles. 

Although the mechanics remain unknown, 
it is possible to instantly travel from one of these bird-like structures to another. 
As such, using the area around those statues as a base of operations is highly recommended.

TextData.SourceString:
Intro: 
This Survival Guide contains the sum of our hard-earned knowledge, 
gained through grueling first-hand experiences. 

Too much happens on these islands that defies common sense. 
If you ever get stuck, look to this guide for help.

TextData.SourceString:
Of all the resources you can gather from nature, 
<itemName id=|Wood|/> is the foundation for nearly every tool and structure. 

Pick up fallen branches or strike nearby trees to start collecting.
TextData.LocalizedString:
Of all the resources you can gather from nature, 
<itemName id=|Wood|/> is the foundation for nearly every tool and structure. 

Pick up fallen branches or strike nearby trees to start collecting.

TextData.SourceString:
Materials on their own are merely raw resources. 
By assembling a Workbench, you'll gain the ability to craft more complex items. 

Open the Build menu, select the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>, and choose where to place it. 
This marks your first step to building your base and surviving these wilds.

TextData.SourceString:
On this island, coexistence with Pals is the key to survival. 
And it all begins with a single device: the <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>. 

Open the Technology menu and study its blueprint. 
The time has come to reclaim the power of the ancients.

TextData.SourceString:
These islands are home to an extraordinary mineral infused with supernatural energy: 
an ore known as Paldium. 
It's believed to be deeply connected to the massive tree towering in the distance, 
though the details remain a mystery. 

What we do know is that Paldium is a versatile material essential for crafting <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s. 
It's commonly found near water, so explore riversides and wetlands. 

If you spot something glowing blue, try striking it with a pickaxe. 
You can craft a pickaxe by combining <itemName id=|Stone|/> and <itemName id=|Wood|/> at a <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>.

TextData.SourceString:
<itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s are vessels used to capture Pals. 
Think of them as your key to companionship.

Craft <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s by combining materials at a <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>. 
All you need is <itemName id=|Wood|/>, <itemName id=|Stone|/>, and <itemName id=|Pal_crystal_S|/>s.

TextData.SourceString:
Throw a <itemName id=|PalSphere|/> at a Pal to try and capture it. 
To boost your chances for success, weaken it first. 
Once you catch your first Pal, the two of you can form a bond unlike any other.

TextData.SourceString:
To truly coexist with Pals, proper management is essential. 
Ancient records describe storage technology known as the <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/>.
 
Open the Technology screen to learn how to build one. 
The <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/> also has the ability to heal injured Pals.

TextData.SourceString:
Open the Build menu with <keyGuideIcon id=|OpenConstructionMenu| iconScale=|0.7|/> and place a <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/> on a wide, open stretch of land. 
This will be your first base with your Pals—your launch point for future expeditions. 

If you maintain it well, it will become a vital stronghold when the time comes to face a tower, 
so choose your location carefully.

Access the <mapObjectName id=|PalBoxV2|/>, open the Management menu, and assign one of your Pals to the base.

TextData.SourceString:
Whether you're battling or exploring, you can't forget to eat. 
Fortunately, this island is home to plants that bear delicious fruit. 

Keep an eye out for <itemName id=|Berries|/>. 
If you find some, open your inventory and use them to satisfy your hunger.

TextData.SourceString:
The unforgiving wilds of the Palpagos Islands show mercy to no one. 
To protect yourself from the cold and harm, you'll need proper clothing. 

Unlock the <itemName id=|ClothArmor|/> technology and craft it at the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>. 
You'll need <itemName id=|Cloth|/>, which can be made from materials dropped by fluffy Pals that bear <itemName id=|Wool|/>.
 
Time to go find something soft and wooly!

TextData.SourceString:
Gaining EXP and honing your skills are the keys to overcoming the challenges ahead. 
Once you level up, open your inventory and enhance one of your stats. 
Don't fear change—after all, every journey begins with a single brave step.

TextData.SourceString:
Only the strong survive on the Palpagos Islands.
<characterName id=|SheepBall|/> sit at the very bottom of the food chain, making them easy to catch. 

But don't underestimate them. 
Their dexterity makes them surprisingly useful for all kinds of tasks. 

Try capturing five <characterName id=|SheepBall|/> to start. 
They'll be dependable first companions as you grow your base. 
Plus, they can provide essential materials like <itemName id=|Wool|/> and <itemName id=|Meat_SheepBall|/>. 

In this harsh world, the key to survival is simple: use every resource you can.

Unlock the <itemName id=|Shield_01|/> technology and craft it at the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench|/>. 
Equip it ahead of time, and you'll be ready for whatever surprise attacks come your way.

With this tool in hand, even the highest drop becomes an easy-breezy descent.

TextData.SourceString:
This device includes a feature called the Palpedia, which collects and stores information on Pals. 
It can hold data for up to 12 individuals per species. 

Capturing more Pals also rewards you with bonus EXP. 
Start by catching 30 different Pals. 

With a wide range of abilities on your team, you'll be ready to take on even more powerful foes.

TextData.SourceString:
Each Pal has a unique Partner Skill with different effects depending on its species. 
Some can be equipped and controlled directly, while others can be ridden as mounts. 

First, unlock the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench_SkillUnlock|/> technology and set one up at your base. 
Then, unlock the <itemName id=|SkillUnlock_Kitsunebi|/> to craft it at your <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench_SkillUnlock|/>.
 
Unlike other items, Pal Gear is stored in the Key Items space next to your Inventory.

TextData.SourceString:
Powerful Pals have carved out their own territories across the Palpagos Islands. 
They can be dangerous, but defeating them yields experience, 
and capturing them earns you formidable new allies.
 
How you deal with them is up to you. 
Rumors whisper of a Pal called {targetpal} somewhere in these wilds.

Track it down. Whether you capture or defeat it is up to you.

TextData.SourceString:
Pals hatch from Pal Eggs. 
You can find these eggs all over the islands, so keep a sharp eye out while exploring. 

Raising Pals from Pal Eggs can lead you to rare and unique new allies. 
Who knows? One day, you might just hatch the perfect Pal. 

Start by unlocking the <mapObjectName id=|HatchingPalEgg|/> technology and setting one up at your base. 
Once you place an egg inside, you'll need to wait a while for it to hatch.

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, I haven't seen you around before. 
Say, would you mind doing me a favor? 
If you have a Pal that can water crops, could you give it to me? 
There used to be plenty of Water Pals around here, but there aren't many left. 
Some shady group came through and took nearly all of them...
including my hardworking little Pal who always helped me with my fields. 
Lend me a hand, and I'll make sure you're properly rewarded.

TextData.SourceString:
Hello there! Feeling hungry by any chance? 
I just baked a cake with my family's secret recipe, but I got a little carried away. 
Now I have way more cake than I can possibly stomach by myself. 
It'd be a shame to let it go to waste, 
so would you mind sharing some with one of your Pals? 
I hope they've got a sweet tooth!

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, are you an adventurer? Perfect timing! 
Could you deliver this special dish to the settlement nearby for me? 

Give it to the super dependable-looking one
-you'll recognize him right away. 

...What? Why don't I take it myself? 
Well, it's just that the dish smells so good that Pals keep swarming me, 
and I can't get anywhere near the place. 

So please, I'm counting on you! 
Just make sure the Pals don't eat it on the way!

The treatment is so expensive, I can't afford it on my own. 
I need 5,000 Gold Coins to cover the cost. 
I'm begging you—I promise to find a way to repay you somehow!

TextData.SourceString:
Oh ho, you there! 
This is a bit sudden, but have you heard 
the old tales of the legendary Pals said to roam these parts? 

I've been studying them for many long years now, 
but not once have I laid eyes on one. 

Not even a glimpse. 
So I was wondering, would you be willing to search for them in my stead? 
My legs aren't what they used to be, see... 

Rumor has it that there's at least one legendary Pal in each of these places: 
Mount Obsidian to the west, the Astral Mountains to the north, 
the Desiccated Dunes out east, and the remote land folks call Feybreak. 

See that tall, jagged rock over there? 
If you climb to the top, you should get a good view. 

If you do manage to find one of those legendary Pals, 
would you be kind enough to let an old man see it with his own eyes? 

I'll be waiting, my friend.

At this point, my motivation is hanging on by a thread... But wait, I've got it! 

There are Pals out there that can boost work efficiency. 
If I had one of those, maybe that would turn things around! 
Ideally, it'd be a Pal that could handle these harsh mountain cliffs without breaking a sweat.
 
So if you happen to find one, would you mind giving it to me?
In return, I'll give you something nice I dug up around the ruins. 
Something REAL special!

Wow, you must really want to be friends with me. 
Weirdo. 

...All right, then. If you've got so much time on your hands, 
how about doing me a favor? 

There's this group we've been butting heads with forever, 
and lately some of my crew got roughed up by them. 

So I figured maybe you could give them a little payback. 
They go on and on about |protecting Pals| and |living in harmony with nature,| 
but when it comes down to it, they're just as violent as anyone else. 

We call them the Free Pal Alliance as a kind of joke. 
But don't get the wrong idea. 
Just because I said I respect your skills doesn't mean I trust you, got it?!

TextData.SourceString:
You know... once, I ran away from the group with Grizzbolt. 

It was freezing at night. 
I remember trying to stay warm, and finding this old scrap of cloth somewhere. 

Just a rag, really, but looking back... 
I think that was the first time I'd ever shared something with someone. 

Come to think of it, we were hiding in some ruins not too far from here. 

...Hey, could you try and find it for me? 
You're the only one I could ever ask for something like this...

TextData.SourceString:
Each Pal has a unique Partner Skill with different effects depending on its species. 
Some can be equipped and controlled directly, while others can be ridden as mounts. 

First, unlock the <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench_SkillUnlock|/> technology and set one up at your base. 
Then, unlock the <itemName id=|SkillUnlock_Carbunclo|/> to craft it at your <mapObjectName id=|WorkBench_SkillUnlock|/>.
 
Unlike other items, Pal Gear is stored in the Key Items space next to your Inventory.

But, hey! Maybe our paths'll cross again sometime. 
Bwahaha!


Well, on that note... 
Here's hopin' the gods stay good to ya, {PlayerName}!

Figured I'd be seein' ya soon enough.

Another day, another request, eh? 
This time, it's... Well, a young lad over in that village was raisin' a Pal,
but it went haywire.

Mhm, it's been happenin' a lot more lately. 
Don't seem to matter if the Pal was wild or hand-reared. 
They get so aggressive, I swear, it's like they've been possessed...

Anyways, that Pal flew into a rage, attacked that kid's parents, then ran off. 
They're still out cold, and in serious condition. 
I was told the Pal oughta be around here, but...

.........

Hey, buddy? ...Would ya mind takin' this one on? 
The reward'd be all yours, plus I'd throw in some extra for the trouble.

Much as I hate to admit it, I think this gig's just...too much for me.

TextData.SourceString:
Like I said before, I used to be a Pal Tamer. 
I might not've been on your level, but |defeat| wasn't in my dictionary. 
...At least not until I got to this here World Tree.

Right here's where I lost my partner. 
Somethin' about it drove 'em insane. 
Things...get kinda fuzzy after that.

I thought that I could find some answers in this damn oversized bush, 
but I wasn't worth a passin' glance. 
The World Tree wouldn't give me the time o' day, so...

I ran. I gave every excuse under the sun 
for why I couldn't put down the Pal who'd been with me,
right from when I was a young sprout.

I turned my back on my duty, and turned a blind eye to their wishes. 
Started helpin' folks to ignore the guilt, and prayin' to some nameless god. 
Not that I ever once believed in 'em. 

...Nah, I feel like meetin' ya was inevitable. 
You've given me the courage I need to step up and do what I should've, 
all those years ago...

I can't say I deserve it, 
but that why I was hopin' you'd be there to see how it all ends.

TextData.SourceString:
Harvest Wood & Build a Workbench

These islands are rich in natural resources such as Wood and Stone.
To conserve our supplies and continue the survey for as long as possible, 
we'll need to take advantage of them.

First, Wood. 
There are two ways to gather it: 
either collect the wood already on the ground, 
or strike at a nearby tree.

Once you've got those materials in hand, 
find a safe space and set up a Workbench.

TextData.SourceString:
Making <itemName id=|PalSphere|/>s and Capturing Pals

As you may have noticed, this island is home to a variety of strange creatures.
Known as |Pals,| these intelligent creatures come in a wide range of shapes and sizes. 
Of course, our activities here would benefit greatly if we were able to harness their abilities.

Pals can be captured by a |<itemName id=|PalSphere|/>|. 
While the exact principles are still unclear, 
it's possible to tame any Pal by catching it with a Sphere.

First, check the Technology screen for details, 
then obtain the <itemName id=|Pal_crystal_S|/> required for crafting. 
This strange ore glows with a pale blue light, and is often found near sources of water.

Once you finish building your Spheres on a Workbench, you're set to go.

Make sure to wear down the Pal you want to capture. 
Lowering their Health will increase the chances of a successful capture.

That being said, most Pals will resist capture, and will fight back.
Start by focusing on smaller, weaker Pals until you get better equipment.

TextData.SourceString:
Pal Labor

Interacting with a Palbox allows you to manage and utilize your Pals efficiently. 

First, check the Technology screen for details, 
then build a Palbox in a safe location.

The Palbox can be used to store Pals you have on hand, 
or summon them to the box's location.
Pals summoned from the Palbox can only move within a certain radius of the Palbox. 
As such, the location of your Palbox inevitably becomes the centerpoint of your base.

Pals summoned from a Palbox will find work to occupy themselves with, 
based on their own unique traits. 
You can increase the efficiency of your operations by capturing and utilizing more Pals.

TextData.SourceString:
Obtaining Food

Long-term operations also require a reliable source of food.
Luckily, the <itemName id=|Berries|/> found in various locations 
can be consumed raw.
 
Some wild Pals are edible, too.
As heart-wrenching as it may be to butcher such adorable creatures...
We must do whatever is necessary to survive.

Utilizing <characterName id=|SheepBall|/>s

<characterName id=|SheepBall|/>s lack any real sort of offensive power, making them easy to catch. 
Moreover, they are dexterous enough to handle a wide variety of tasks, 
making them an excellent choice for the early stages of any base expansion.

which are both necessary for survival. 
Start by capturing your own small flock, then watch your base begin to flourish.

TextData.SourceString:
Crafting Equipment

First, use the Wool obtained from a <characterName id=|SheepBall|/> to craft <itemName id=|Cloth|/> at a Workbench, then use that to craft a set of <itemName id=|ClothArmor|/>. 

Next, put craft a <itemName id=|Shield_01|/> which utilizes the self-restorative properties of Paldium.

Finally, craft a <itemName id=|Glider_Old|/>, which will make it much easier to navigate the difficult terrain.

Equipping these will make your activities here much easier.

TextData.SourceString:
It's called the World Tree.

We barely made it to this island alive, 
then had to spend most of our time doing what we could to prepare to leave it in one piece. 

We searched everywhere, looking for anything that would give us a hint for a way out...
Until the only place we hadn't looked was the World Tree.

Although we were originally a team of seven, 
by the time we reached the World Tree, I was the only one left.

...And here I am, still here.

But, there's something about you... 

For some reason, I think you'll be the one to finally unlock 
the secrets of the World Tree, and bring change to this island.

I can see it in your eyes. 
You've got the right sort of fire in them.
The kind that only burns brighter with each challenge you face.

...Try starting off by heading for that tower over there.

TextData.SourceString:
Each region has one, and they're all controlled by a different faction. 
The tower you're staring at right now belongs to an organization called 
the Rayne Syndicate.

Our survey group couldn't afford to complicate things, so we gave it a wide berth.
But... Well, I suspect it might be holding a clue or two.

There's a little settlement not too far from it, so you might want to start there. 
The folks that live there are all the generous sort, 
so they'll be sure to lend you a hand.

...Heh! Sorry, it's just that I can tell you're already itching to go. 
Don't worry, I won't keep you any longer.
Go on, get a move on!

I'll be rooting for you. I hope your journey bears fruit.

Ho there, traveler! Hm...? Is that a <characterName id=|Kitsunebi|/>? 
Oho, and you even crafted a <itemName id=|SkillUnlock_Kitsunebi|/>!

Ah, my apologies. 
I didn't mean to suggest you weren't the capable sort.

While <characterName id=|Kitsunebi|/> are on the smaller side, 
they're rather wary creatures that pack a rather nasty punch. 

It took us a team of people and several traps before we finally caught one of our own.

Heh! You could probably give the Rayne Syndicate a good bit of trouble, too. 
Still, you'll want to stay on your guard. 
You can worry about the tower once you're sufficiently prepared.

May fortune follow you, my friend.

TextData.SourceString:
You defeated the young woman you believe to be Zoe, 
and obtained a mysterious object resembling a Pal Sphere left lying nearby.
 
Go back to the Small Settlement and ask the Chief about it.

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, greetings, traveler. 
Where did you get to?

Y-You defeated Zoe?! The boss of the Rayne Syndicate, in her own tower?! 
How incredibly bold of you… And here I thought you merely went to talk to her.

I see, so she was the one who provoked the fight...
Oh, beg pardon, traveler, but that item you hold in your hand...
She dropped it in her retreat, so you brought it with you? I-I see.

Hrmm, even if you defeated her in battle, to steal her belongings…
Er, no, never mind me...

So, suffice it to say, you weren’t able to talk with her. 
But that sphere you hold in your hand...
I believe it’s a Key Sphere.

I heard about it a long while ago from my late grandfather, 
who used to study ancient civilizations.

He told me about relics of those ancient civilizations called Key Spheres 
hidden within soaring towers, and how Pal Spheres were created 
by analyzing and repurposing parts of Key Sphere technology.

Zoe would, of course, be the one to ask for more details about it, but, well...
Perhaps give her a little time. I’m not exactly sure what kind of person she is, 
but maybe she’ll be more approachable after cooling down.

TextData.SourceString:
You again! 
I was just about to go looking for you, and yet here you come waltzing on up to me! 
After what you pulled last time, you... Wait, is that my Key Sphere?!

I thought I’d lost it!
You had it the whole time?!
You think that it's okay to beat someone down and steal their stuff?!

…Hmph, whatever. Just keep it.

So yeah, it’s a Key Sphere.
My father told me long ago that the eight towers around the islands 
each have one sealed away inside.

He also said that only those with power should wield them.
I still believe that.
That’s why you should keep it, since you challenged me for it.

Huh? You didn’t come to challenge me? 
You just wanted to talk?
Wh-… Why didn’t you say something sooner?!

F-Fine, whatever! The fact is, you ended up beating me,
so I’m letting you keep the Key Sphere. 

But that doesn’t mean I think you’re worthy of it or anything!
I’m just putting faith in my father’s judgment!

Okay, you got what you came for, so get out of here.

…What? What else could you possibly need?

I don't really know what exactly the Key Spheres are. 
I do remember my father telling me all sorts of complicated stuff about them though, 
like them originally being parts for something and being used to seal something away...

Well, there are seven others, so maybe you’ll find out more if you collect all eight of them…
Wh-What's that look on your face?! Stop looking at me with a look of vague disappointment!

For a Pal Tamer, you really are a pain, you know that?! 
Just get out of here already!

TextData.SourceString:
You may have beaten Auri, but it seems as if she wasn't putting her all into the fight.

Something about that makes her feel different from the other tower leaders.
Talk with her and find out why.

TextData.SourceString:
Ah, there you are. 
You sure put up a hell of a fight!

How long has it been since I've found someone who could actually put me to the test...? 
It's been so long!

Our battle had me practically tingling with excitement!
Tell me, what's your name?

{PlayerName}, huh? It suits you. 
Well, {PlayerName}, let's get right to business!

Why so surprised? You were a worthy opponent! 
And a fine contest of strength deserves a deep conversation afterwards, wouldn't you agree?
I mean, so long as the contest doesn't prove fatal, hahaha!

Now then! 
For starters, let me get a good look at your face.

Hmm... Yes, yes, I see... 
Fine eyes, just as I expected. 
And plenty capable, from what I've seen.

Yes, I don't imagine she'll complain...
Oh, sorry, just talking to myself.

By the way, you want to go to the World Tree, correct? 
I can tell just by looking at you.

I'd like to help you get there. It'd be convenient for me as well.

Not that I intend to fly you there myself or anything... 
...More like providing you with the necessary information.

Sorry, but this might take some time to explain. 
Come talk to me again once you're ready to hear the full story!

TextData.SourceString:
Welcome back, {PlayerName}.
You ready to hear a long story?

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, so you just wanted to come see me!
I applaud your honesty, hahaha!

TextData.SourceString:
All right then! So...

Hmm... I'm still not sure where to even start...

Ahem!

So, as I said before, I'd like you to reach the World Tree.
I'll start by explaining why.

Seeing as you've come this far, {PlayerName}, you must have seen a great deal of the islands. 

You've probably realized by now that, just like in any other place,
there are always light and dark sides to the human endeavors here: 

some coexist, some dominate, some pillage, some lose themselves in their ideologies, 
and some operate in secret to hold sway over others.

But from my perspective, those are all to be expected. 
It's not a matter of good or evil, so much as people being people.

However, there's a great evil enveloping this land; 
an undying motive awakening from an eternal slumber, 
seeking to manipulate all things living and dead to consume the islands
...no, the very world itself.

It rests within the abyss of the World Tree.

...The Calamity.

By now, you must have at least heard some rumors
about the unprecedented disaster that once struck the islands.

I assure you that it's no mere legend or fairy tale. 
Some millennia ago, the most advanced civilization ever on this planet was wiped out overnight.

It was brought on by a world-devouring white dragon... and a lone researcher.

Of course, the people stood in opposition, 
but they proved no match against such a malevolent force.

Their civilization fell to ruin, but they were still able to seal away 
the Calamity within the depths of the World Tree.

However, this wasn't enough to put a complete stop to the dragon's devastation.
Even now, it continues to drain the life essence of the World Tree.

You could say that the World Tree is the heart of this land; 
the energy it generates, and sends through its roots to the farthest corners of the islands 
are vital to the survival of all life here.

This is especially true of Pals, with their strong bonds to the World Tree. 
It's caused some to fall into extremely agitated states and start rampaging. 
You must have seen them on your way here.

Should the dragon completely drain the World Tree of its energy and grow powerful enough 
to destroy the seal, it would mean the end of this world.

{PlayerName}, 
you must reach the core of the World Tree before that monster fully awakens, 
and somehow find a way to put an end to it, once and for all.

I know you have what it takes.

...
Hahaha! I've never seen your face like that before!
I guess all this information must have been overwhelming?

Hey, I know it's a grandiose request, but you don't need to worry! I told you I'd help, right?

And if push comes to shove, well, I'm prepared to get involved as well.
So, straight to the World Tree!


...Is what I'd like to say, but its entrance is blocked by a special barrier. 
It was set up after the Calamity was sealed, to keep out any unwanted trespassers.

However there is a way to open the barrier and guide you to the World Tree... <characterName id=|KingWhale|/>. 
It's the last survivor of a seafaring tribe dedicated to protecting the island.

You'll first have to prove your strength to it. 
Once it recognizes your capabilities, it should open the path for you to reach the World Tree.

How do I know that? 
Because of... an old promise. 

You'll need to prove yourself to fulfill that promise, though. 
I'll tell you where <characterName id=|KingWhale|/> is, but you won't be able to meet it through ordinary means. 
I imagine it's going to be a bit of a trial, actually! Hahaha!

Okay, you'd best be off, {PlayerName}. 
If anyone can put a stop to the Calamity, it's you!

and somehow find a way to put an end to it, once and for all.

I know you have what it takes.

...
Hahaha! I've never seen your face like that before!
I guess all this information must have been overwhelming?

Hey, I know it's a grandiose request, but you don't need to worry! I told you I'd help, right?

And if push comes to shove, well, I'm prepared to get involved as well.
So, straight to the World Tree!


...Is what I'd like to say, but its entrance is blocked by a special barrier. 
It was set up after the Calamity was sealed, to keep out any unwanted trespassers.

However there is a way to open the barrier and guide you to the World Tree... <characterName id=|KingWhale|/>. 
It's the last survivor of a seafaring tribe dedicated to protecting the island.

You'll first have to prove your strength to it. 
Once it recognizes your capabilities, it should open the path for you to reach the World Tree.

How do I know that? 
Because of... an old promise. 

You'll need to prove yourself to fulfill that promise, though. 
I'll tell you where <characterName id=|KingWhale|/> is, but you won't be able to meet it through ordinary means. 
I imagine it's going to be a bit of a trial, actually! Hahaha!

Okay, you'd best be off, {PlayerName}. 
If anyone can put a stop to the Calamity, it's you!

I'm counting on you, {PlayerName}. 
Hey, no need to worry. 
I've got a feeling you'll pull it off somehow.

And I've always been told that my intuition is pretty accurate! 
Hahaha!

TextData.SourceString:

and it’s agreed to help you break through the barrier. 

Head to the World Tree and find a way inside.

TextData.SourceString:
You’ve at last set foot within the World Tree. 
Its interior is filled with a mystical atmostphere, and yet you still feel a sense of unease.

After looking around for a bit, you see someone.
TextData.LocalizedString:

After looking around for a bit, you see someone.

TextData.SourceString:
Halt! Don't move!

Wait... a human? 
Identify yourself.
How did you get in here?

...

<characterName id=|KingWhale|/>... 
That's a name I haven't heard in a long time.

Then that must mean you're...

Forgive my rudeness. 
It's been so long since we've seen any humans besides ourselves in here.

I'm part of a... security detail of sorts for the World Tree. 
Our numbers have dwindled over the years, 
and we now consist of only myself and two others.

Would you mind telling me your name?

{PlayerName}, is it? I'll be sure to remember it well.
So, {PlayerName}, you've come to stop the Calamity?

I understand why. 
The World Tree grows weaker with every passing day. 
I can tell from how desolate it's become in here. 
It's practically a shadow of its former self. 

We're nearly of out time. 
They could awaken at any moment and bring about the dreaded Calamity once more.

...Oh, my apologies. 
By |they,| I mean the two imprisoned here: 
<characterName id=|WorldTreeDragon|/>, the white dragon of the Calamity, 
and its master, Zenara: history's greatest sinner.

Zenara was a biologist who strove for peaceful coexistence between people and Pals. 
No one was more deeply earnest, more rigorous in their approach, 
or cared more for Pals than her.

The Calamity was our burden to bear. 
We never meant for the people of your time to shoulder it.

But we... or rather, I, was too powerless to stop it. 
Even with my connection to the World Tree allowing me to transcend mortality 
and live on for millennia, those two are still beyond my reach.

...Forgive me, I lost myself in self-pity for a moment.

I know this is selfish of me to ask, {PlayerName}, but I'm begging you.
Please, find them, and set them free.

I'm counting on you, {PlayerName}.

We'll keep up the fight here as we always have, 
and try to stave off the World Tree's decay for as long as we're able.

I vow that we'll buy you as much time as we can, 
for you to free the dragon and Zenara... even if it costs us our lives.

You have nothing to worry about. 
In this matter, we're seasoned veterans here. 
After all, we've spent millennia fighting this exact battle.

...Sorry, that was meant to lighten the mood. 
I guess I've lost my touch for humor over all these years.

and the Calamity that sleeps at its core. 

The moment of truth is nearly upon you.

TextData.SourceString:
The white dragon of the Calamity and its master have awakened from their eternal slumber. 
No words are exchanged.

The only thing left now is to end it all.

TextData.SourceString: You’ve released the mysterious figure from the cage…
TextData.LocalizedString: You’ve released the mysterious figure from the cage…

TextData.SourceString:
You encountered a researcher from an ancient civilization 
on a solitary island strewn with gargantuan remains. 

Her research seems to have hit a dead end.
TextData.LocalizedString:
You encountered a researcher from an ancient civilization 
on a solitary island strewn with gargantuan remains. 

Her research seems to have hit a dead end.

TextData.SourceString:
Hwaaah! Who is that?!

Y-You’re… a human? 
...My apologies. I never imagined I’d meet another person here...

Umm, judging from your appearance, 
you must be a Pal Tamer, correct?

I’m a researcher here studying ancient civilizations. 
I’ve been searching for signs of giant whale remains in various regions.

Oh, tell me if you’ve heard of this mystery! 
These remains are supposed to be enshrined in the prairies, 
the volcano, the snowy mountains, and even here on this remote island!

They’re thought to belong to a species of massive, prehistoric, whale-like Pals!

…Ahem, sorry, I tend to get carried away on the subject. 
Anyhow, I continued tracking down these remains, and the search led me to this island. 
And now that I’ve come all the way here…!

…I’m completely stuck.

Come now, no need to look so concerned! 
I've found a clue here. Look at that shrine there.

From what I’ve discovered, it responds to a specific kind of frequency. 
Sound, in particular. But I don't know exactly what sound.

I have a hunch that the key rests in each of the four regions, 
particularly with the giant whale bones. 
But, alas, I’m no Pal Tamer…

Oh, if I only had a Pal’s mobility! 
Even just crossing the waters to get to this island was a real challenge...

That’s why I’d like to ask for your help. 
Could you investigate the four regions for me? 
I’ll be sure to reward you handsomely, of course!

And anything you find on the journey is yours by right, naturally. 
All I want out of it is to finally solve this mystery!

So, what do you say? 
It’s just as good a deal for you as it is for me, I imagine!

What?! 
You’re actually going to make me struggle all on my own?! 
I guess I’ve got a long swim ahead of me...
TextData.LocalizedString:
What?! 
You’re actually going to make me struggle all on my own?! 
I guess I’ve got a long swim ahead of me...

TextData.SourceString:
Hmm? Yes, what is it?

Oh, are you willing to help me after all?! 
Really, truly?!
TextData.LocalizedString:
Hmm? Yes, what is it?

Oh, are you willing to help me after all?! 
Really, truly?!

TextData.SourceString:
WHOOOO!!
I knew you wouldn’t let me down! 
Okay, let me show you the locations!

Oh, I just remembered, there’s one other clue I found!

Here you go!
TextData.LocalizedString:
WHOOOO!!
I knew you wouldn’t let me down! 
Okay, let me show you the locations!

Oh, I just remembered, there’s one other clue I found!

Here you go!

TextData.SourceString:
It’s some kind of schematic I found during my investigation. 
It’s a bit too deteriorated to properly make out, 
but it appears to be for some kind of musical instrument. 

You know what this means, right? 
The shrine reacting to sounds, and now this schematic for a musical instrument…

Exactly! The item outlned in this schematic is the key! 
It holds the secret to the shrine!

IT HAS TO!!

…Uh, sorry, I got carried away again. Ahem.

Anyhow, please take the schematic with you. 
I hope it aids you in your search!

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, and by the way, I'd really appreciate if you could 
sort out the investigation as soon as possible! 
I’m getting a little tired of eating fish here…

Huh? Why not go back to the mainland? 
I couldn’t turn my back on this mystery like that. 
It's a matter of pride!

It’d be like a Pal Tamer finding a new species of Pal and not trying to catch it! 
You can understand that feeling, right?!

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, there you are! 
Welcome back!

Well? How’d it go?!

…

Oh…

Whoa!

WHOAAA!

Is that a flute you have there?! 
It IS! And it’s a BONE flute!

Is it the bone from the gargantuan remains? 
How did you manufacture it? 
And what kind of sound does it make?!

Oops, I’ve forgotten my manners again. 
Sorry, I just get so excited.

But a flute! It makes total sense! 
I wonder what kind of effect it will have on the shrine… 
Let’s go give it a try, right now!

Oh, wait, I suppose we don’t really know what we’re in for.
Best make sure you’re fully prepared before we go! 
You’ve only got yourself to blame if anything goes wrong!

Oooh, I can’t wait to see what happens when we blow the flute! 
There has to be something hidden on this island…

My investigation thus far shows that it’s something that covers the whole land mass. 
Some kind of invisible force field.

It could be the same type as what the World Tree has, yes… 
Hrm, hrm…

TextData.SourceString:
Hwah! Are you all right?!

The shrine lit up like a star the moment you blew the flute! 
When I could finally see again, you’d vanished!

…Huh? A whale? 
It was there?! 
Y-You fought it? And you won?!

…

Huh. I’m sorry, this is a lot to take in. 
I’m not sure how to respond…

Still, This is incredible! 
To think that such a massive Pal thought to be extinct 
since prehistoric times still exists!

…

Uh, sorry! I just got lost in thought.

But it feels like I’ve got a lot more information to delve through now, 
and I owe it all to you!

I think I should stay here a little longer and continue my research.

But first things first, your reward! 
I really appreciate all your help. 
I hope to see you around again sometime!

TextData.SourceString:
It's certain that the Pal Tamer was transported somewhere else...
Maybe a different dimension...

If so, then maybe that force field is actually 
a barrier that fundamentally partitions space? 
And the World Tree’s is essentially the same, so…

I can understand hiding your own habitat, but why the World Tree?
It’s sealed off, and it's obviously for a specific reason…

And the whale bones were scattered in a very unnatural manner.
They’re scars from a calamitous disaster that must have occurred a very long time ago. 
There's definitely something ominous about the World Tree…

Hrm, hrm…

TextData.SourceString:
(The <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> suddenly drops something to the ground. 
It appears to be a kind of bag that was fastened to its neck.)
TextData.LocalizedString:
(The <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> suddenly drops something to the ground. 
It appears to be a kind of bag that was fastened to its neck.)

TextData.SourceString:
(You find what appears to be a journal inside the bag. 
The erratic handwriting offers a glimpse into the desperate situation at the time.
 It reads as follows:)

|To whomever reads this, I’m entrusting you with my <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/>.|

|I ran into it on the island of dancing cherry blossoms, 
where some lowborn filth had been antagonizing it, and we’ve traveled together since. 
But it seems my journey ends here.|

|I took on a request to help a local village that was being threatened 
by a rampaging Pal, but I wasn’t up to the task.|

|We managed to give it the slip, 
but it has a strong sense of smell. It’s sure to find us any moment now. |

|When it does... well, with me missing an arm 
and my companion already on death's door, the outcome is obvious.|

|But the less needless deaths, the better.
I prepared for the worst and picked up some Memory Wiping Medicine from a traveling merchant. 
I'll feed it to my <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> and let it loose. 
That way it should go searching for its forgotten master and won't linger in this area any longer.|

|My <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> has been tormented by humans ever since it was a pup, 
so it detests anyone other than its master. |

|If only I could believe that this medicine 
would make it forget all of the hurt and hatred it's learned...

|I feel the deepest remorse towards the villagers who entrusted me with this task. 
The least that I could do is to take that rampaging Pal out with me.|

|It's time. Though I know it's selfish to ask, 
I hope you'll help my <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> find happiness now that it's lost everything else.|

(You finish reading and look up to see the <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/> staring straight at you. 
It's apparent to you that it hasn't forgotten anything. 
In fact, it seems to be actively searching for its master.)

(But judging from its wounds, the incident in the journal wasn't recent. 
To think that this Pal has been wandering all this time despite what happened…)

(Memory Wiping Medicine shouldn't typically have an effect on Pals, 
but it must have erased this <characterName id=|AmaterasuWolf_Dark|/>'s memories of its escape.)

TextData.SourceString:
You listened to the recording left behind by a guardian 
stationed near the center of the World Tree. 

Use the attached coordinates to find further leads.

TextData.SourceString:
I don't have much time left.
I leave this final recording for those who follow.

Today, we World Tree Guardians have begun a large-scale offensive operation. 
We were determined to break the seal and put an end to that monster trapped within, 
before it drains the World Tree dry to make itself whole and rise once more.

Our long-term strategy was paying off; 
today is the closest we've come to striking a definitive blow since the Calamity.

But alas... We were unable to breach the seal, 
blocked by this damned barrier in front of us.

None of our attempts to destroy it have produced any results...
We could do nothing as we heard the desperate screams over the transmissions.

We'd sent out diversionary units all around the World Tree 
while those of us in the main force led the assault.

It was not long after we began our assault on the barrier 
that those units started reporting appearances of ferocious Pals unlike any they'd seen before.

It's almost certain that the barrier had something to do with their appearance.
We tried to do what we could to save our allies, but...

For some unexplainable reason, the Pals in our area converged on us; 
not just the ones that were always aggressive, but the usually timid ones as well. 
It was as if they were being compelled by a greater force.

The main force has been annihilated, and those of us still alive are all on our last breaths. 
I'm leaving this recording and the coordinates as a last act of resistance.
So, to whoever hears this...

Please, don't let our sacrifice be in vain.

We've lived for close to an eternity, 
and yet we've failed to accomplish even a single one of our objectives. 
Please, don't let our struggle be forgotten.

TextData.SourceString:
Oh, hey… You're not from around here, are you? 
Did you…come from the surface?

Whoa, that's pretty wild! 
It's not often a surface-dweller makes their way up here to Sunreach...

So this must also be your first time seeing the tornado, right? 
It hides the tower where Lady Auri resides.

Rumor has it that any outsider who can shut down the six devices around the island 
will dispel the tornado and earn the right to challenge Lady Auri.

It does sound like some tired old legend though, 
I'll admit. And even if it's true, we don't really get outsiders here in the first place.

…Or at least, we didn't until now. 
I still can't believe I'm actually meeting one myself. 
Must be my lucky day!

So yeah, you should give it a shot! 
It's not like you get these kinds of opportunities on the surface, right?

And if you actually do manage to pass her test, 
then it was totally worth hyping you up to the task! 
Bwahaha! Good luck out there!

TextData.SourceString:
Hm…? Oh, you must be a Pal Tamer. You heading for the Wildlife Sanctuary?

See that gigantic dome covering that island?

That's a relic from a lost civilization, 
built for the purpose of observing how Pals evolve in extreme conditions.

…Or so the story goes, at least. 
Either ways, the smart thing to do is to steer clear.

I tried going myself once, 
but it was crawling with Pals that were on an entirely different level from the ones here.

What's more, there was also some kind of… machine? 
Keeping a low-altitude patrol of the island. 
My gut told me I would've been a goner if it'd found me.

I immediately left. 
I wasn't gonna let let myself die out of curiosity. 
You stay away too, if you value your life.

TextData.SourceString:
Hm? I take it you're a traveler?

Oh, I'm just a run-of-the-mill physician. 
I treat injured folks here, humans and Pals alike.

...Say, would you happen to be much of a fighter? 
If so, there's a favor I'd like to ask.

I'm not sure if you happened to see any on your way here, but... 
Do you know about the Free Pal Alliance?

They're a peaceful bunch, who've got nothing but love for Pals. 
Or, at least, they USED to be. Something's not quite right with them these days.

Most of the wounded I've seen recently said the Alliance got the better of them. 
And I doubt they'd change their policies without some sort of reason...

How about it? Could you look into that for me?

My most recent patient was a merchant. 
I'm guessing they were using Pals to help carry their luggage.

but they've never straight up attacked someone else for using one.

...

That young girl...

but I need someone to go and double check for me.

There might not even be anything for you to find, but then again... 
Well, she always was an honest kid.

TextData.SourceString:
Consider this my farewell.

....All I ever wanted was for the Pals I loved 
to live out their days in peace and happiness, 
surrounded by pristine nature.

If we all came together as friends and neighbors, 
what could be better than that?

It truly was that simple, in the beginning.

So, I founded the Free Pal Alliance, and devoted myself into enlightening others. 
Though I was mocked for it, I was convinced that I would eventually get through to the skeptics.

...The first time I ever took a human life was the day that I met <characterName id=|LilyQueen|/>. 
When I saw those Rayne Syndicate goons about to harm that noble queen, 
my body moved before I knew it myself.

I do not regret what I did. Only...

I was exhausted. 
No matter how much I tried to win people over with my words, 
none of them wanted to change.

But, even then, I had no intention of abandoning my beliefs.

...At least, not until today.

...I learned that one of our officers had been taking Pals from under our protection 
and selling them to travelers and merchants in nearby settlements.

She had been with us since the group's founding. 
She unmistakeably shared our love for the Pals, but... money had been tight since her divorce. 
That's all it was.

I was in despair and so frustrated. I wanted a reason to finally let it all go. 
So, I pressed her for more answers. Ultimately, she told me...

|I love Pals, but in the end, they're just Pals.|

...Well. Evil can be fought against.
Deliberate crimes can be admonished.

What can we do about those who take it for granted that Pals exist to be exploited?

...This was the moment of truth for me. 
Would I continue to walk the high road, or abandon my morality?

The world is too corrupt.
So, the only answer is... to cleanse it of the corruption.

I have no other options but to let my rage take over...

TextData.SourceString:
...Ah, you want to know more about the Brothers of the Eternal Pyre? 
They used to be fairly chill... for a group that worships fire. 

They kept to their mountain, and spent their days training. 
When they lost their leader, it seemed like they would completely fizzle out.

That's about when their new head honcho showed up. 
Some guy called Axel. Apparently, the Brothers found him passed out somewhere. 
But he was a pretty passionate guy, for someone who was found down and out.

That really resonated with the group, I guess. 
Ever since then, the Brothers have been, well... a little too hot to handle. 

That's about all I can tell you about them, though. 
If you're planning on digging deeper, try not to burn yourself getting too close.

TextData.SourceString:
...You seem to be an awfully long way from home, Pal Tamer. 
But, if you dared to venture all the way out here, 
then perhaps you wouldn't mind hearing me out.

I've been selling my goods here for ages, but it's gotten much more dangerous these days. 
The PIDF ought to be the ones handling that, but... 
You can't trust a single one of them. Including their leader, Marcus Dryden.

Lately, stims have been running rampant here.
It's terrible stuff... all it does is absolutely ruin the body. 
I've reported it to the PIDF, but all they've managed to do is catch one low-ranking dealer.

They have the gall to charge the residents here exorbitant |protection| fees, 
yet this is the treatment we get. At this rate, the town's going to crumble to dust. 
I couldn't bear to see that happen.

Still, don't just take my word for it. 
Just talk to the others in town,
and see the truth of things for yourself.

But, I believe you've seen all there is to see here. 
As for the next step...

If you head east from here, you'll find an old tunnel hidden in a rock wall. 
The PIDF said it was a stronghold for armed insurgents, and banned anyone from going near it, 
but... I've seen them entering it myself.

...It's a risky request, to be sure. 
Still, I have no one else to rely on.
